Overview

Kyrenia is a city in Kyrenia District with a population of 33,000. A picturesque harbor town on Cyprus’ northern coast, known for its Venetian castle, charming old town, and stunning views of the Kyrenia Mountains. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 310 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
